name: Borobudur Temple Compounds
scaleNote: 0.5 studs per metre. 123 m square and 35 m tall; nine platforms have to be nine distinguishable courses, which sets the floor on the scale.

base.source: Wikipedia, Borobudur: 'The base is 123 m x 123 m (404 ft x 404 ft) in size with 4 metres (13 ft) walls.'

baseWall.source: Wikipedia, Borobudur: 'The base is 123 m x 123 m (404 ft x 404 ft) in size with 4 metres (13 ft) walls.'

height.source: Wikipedia, Borobudur: '35 metres (115 ft) above ground level' at the central dome's top.

note: Nine platforms, the lower six square and the upper three circular, with seventy-two small stupas around one large central stupa (Wikipedia, Borobudur). The six square platforms are a `Ziggurat`; the three circular ones and the 72 stupas are `Dome`s on `arrangeOn` circles. The setback per terrace is uncited -- no source read gives it -- and is derived from the base divided by the terrace count.
